name: The Business-in-a-Box Generator Database
description: A business-in-a-box generator builds a complete starter kit for a new small business: a one-page plan, a name, a structure, a registration checklist, a startup budget, prices, a marketing plan, a sales funnel, operations, hiring, bookkeeping, tax basics, customer service, a growth plan and a risk register — all in one place, free, in the browser.
